Earlier today, it was unassigned. Would appreciate if someone could pick it up :folded_hands:
Actually it looks like my PRs #37723 and #39287 we're unassigned because of merge conflicts but there they did not get the merge-conflict tag. Does anyone know why?
I think unassignment is just the bot trying to rotate reviewers if there were no response. Conflict is a separare thing that the bot scans for, but its message is often delayed by a few hours
